title: 风起时 第一百零六章 玄月第一卷 风起时 第一百零二章 成了脏东
content_zh:
第一卷：风起时第一百零六章：玄月
核心区域，中央海域，某一座岛屿。
有一头长着两颗长长獠牙的猛虎，正被架在一头沉睡的小狮子上方，被小狮子身上燃烧的火焰不断炙烤，散发着浓郁肉香。
陈风奇就盘坐在一旁，抱着白玉蝉壳，正在疗伤。
可见在他的身上，有一道狰狞伤口，从左肩一直延伸到了腹部。
还能透过伤口，看到他胸腔内，泛着金色纹路的骨头。
甚至连骨头，都出现了道道裂痕。
之前为了击杀这头猛虎异兽，让他也遭受了极为严重的创伤。
尤其是最后关头，猛虎异兽发动天赋的拼死一击，拍出了一道恐怖斩击，方才在他身上留下了这道狰狞伤口。
本来陈风奇并没有斩杀这头异兽的心思，只是想采摘宝药，也的确得手了。
可那异兽见宝药被夺走，立刻如同发了疯，展开了不死不休的架势。
不得不说，这头猛虎异兽的实力，也的确惊人，并且速度奇快，连寒月神通都难以完全命中，让他逃无可逃。
最终，他也被打出了真火，干脆不再想着逃，转而与异兽展开了一场疯狂厮杀。
陈风奇在又吃了不少高品级宝药后，虽然还没有完成八次化生，可实力相较于十天前，已经上升了一个台阶。
可即便如此，仍然身受重创，几乎是手段尽出。
最后还是通过汐象异术，将异兽引到大海深处，以地利优势操控大水，不断消耗折磨异兽，才好不容易将之斩杀。
此刻，随着他不断运转再生异术，可见骨骼上的裂痕正在被快速修复，伤口也在不断愈合。
仅仅片刻功夫，所有肉身的伤势都已经完全恢复。
不过这再生异术，在修复肉身的伤势方面，虽然有着奇效，可对于心神方面的损耗，却没有任何帮助。
所以他仍然能感觉到精神方面的疲惫，让他略感虚弱。

随后，他收起白玉蝉壳，长出了一口气，又瞥了一眼被架在火上烤的异兽，哼声开口。
“你说你，本来都放过你了，就非要往我肚子里跑。”
等到异兽完全烤熟，将整头异兽都吃下肚后，在浓郁灵气因子的滋补下，连仅剩的疲惫与虚弱感，也逐渐消失了。
陈风奇满足地拍着肚子，感觉自己又行了。
一旁，小石头又在干劲十足地啃着一堆异兽骨头，一口一个嘎嘣脆，看上去十分忙碌。
陈风奇没有管它，转而开始琢磨起怎么点燃第二盏神照灯。
其中最关键的一点，就是如何映照神通。
他的第一盏神照灯，最终成功映照出了寒月神通。
但当时的情况比较特殊，主要还是为了化解体内的那一口寒井，几乎不可再复制。
他想要映照出第二道神通，就只能用其他方式。
“如果有甲乙宫的神通秘路之法就好了，直接让五灯映照一则神通，根本不用那么麻烦。”
不过陈风奇也知道，每一种秘路之法，都是不传之秘，外人几乎不可能学到。
“总之，先试试吧，就算失败了，也没什么大碍。”
他心中想着，随即取出了三株宝药。
这三株宝药，全都超过了八丈三尺灵光品级，用来点燃第二盏神照灯，可以说是绰绰有余了。
他没有迟疑，直接将三株宝药全部吃下。
现在他已经学聪明了，在采下宝药后，都会先弄下一点边角，尝试一下。
但凡察觉到药效有丁点不对劲的，都会被他留在青铜鼎中，不打算服用。
因为之前的致幻蘑菇，就让他上了大当。
本以为那药效只会让他有一点眩晕感，没什么问题，却因为后劲太大，导致疯魔了好些天。

现在，若没有必要，他就只会吃那些药效完全没有异常的宝药。
而在这十天的时间里，就有那么两株宝药，有大古怪。
甚至这两株宝药中的其中之一，又是一株蘑菇宝药。
那是一株鲜红如血，上面又长满了密密麻麻白色小点的蘑菇，一看就十分诡异，绝不可能会是正常药效的东西。
陈风奇对于蘑菇类的宝药，已经有了很深的抵触，连一点都不想去尝，所以也不清楚其药效。
content_en:
Volume One: When the Wind Rises Chapter 106: Xuan Yue
The core area, the central sea area, a certain island.
There was a tiger with two long fangs, which was being held above a sleeping lion cub. It was being continuously roasted by the flames burning on the cub's body, exuding a rich meaty aroma.
Chen Fengqi was sitting cross-legged aside, holding a white jade cicada shell and healing his wounds.
It can be seen that there is a hideous wound on his body, extending from his left shoulder to his abdomen.
Through the wound, he could still see the golden-colored bones in his chest.
Even the bones had cracks.
In order to kill this tiger beast, he also suffered extremely serious trauma.
Especially at the last moment, the tiger beast unleashed its innate desperate blow and struck a terrifying slash, leaving this hideous wound on his body just now.
Originally, Chen Fengqi had no intention of killing this strange beast. He just wanted to harvest the treasure, and he succeeded.
But when the strange beast saw that the precious medicine was taken away, it immediately seemed to go crazy and launched a desperate posture.
It has to be said that the strength of this tiger beast is indeed astonishing, and its speed is so fast that even Hanyue's magical power cannot completely hit it, leaving him unable to escape.
In the end, he was also beaten to the real fire, and he simply stopped thinking about escaping, and instead started a crazy fight with the alien beast.
After Chen Fengqi took a lot of high-grade treasure medicine, although he has not completed eight transformations, his strength has risen to a higher level than ten days ago.
But even so, he was still severely injured and almost at his wits' end.
In the end, he used tide Xiang's magic to lure the alien beasts to the depths of the sea, controlled the water with geographical advantages, and continuously consumed and tortured the alien beasts before finally killing them.
At this moment, as he continues to use the regeneration technique, it can be seen that the cracks on the bones are being quickly repaired and the wounds are constantly healing.
In just a moment, all physical injuries had been completely recovered.
However, although this regeneration technique is miraculous in repairing physical injuries, it does not help at all in terms of mental wear and tear.
So he could still feel the mental exhaustion, making him slightly weak.
Then, he put away the white jade cicada shell, let out a long breath, glanced at the strange beast being roasted on the fire, and spoke with a hum.
"You said you, even though I let you go, you insist on running into my belly."
After the alien beast was completely roasted and eaten, even the remaining fatigue and weakness gradually disappeared under the nourishment of the rich spiritual energy factor.
Chen Fengqi patted his belly with satisfaction, feeling that he was doing well again.
On the side, Xiao Shitou was gnawing energetically on a pile of bones of exotic animals, crunching each bite, looking very busy.
Chen Fengqi ignored it and began to think about how to light the second magic lamp.
The most critical point is how to reflect magical powers.
His first magical lamp finally succeeded in reflecting Han Yue's magical power.
But the situation at that time was quite special, mainly to resolve the cold well in the body, which is almost impossible to replicate again.
If he wanted to reflect the second magical power, he could only use other methods.
"It would be great if there was a method for the secret path of magical power in Palaces A and B. Just let the five lanterns reflect a magical power. It wouldn't be so troublesome at all."
However, Chen Fengqi also knows that every secret method is a secret that is not taught and is almost impossible for outsiders to learn.
"Anyway, let's try it first. Even if we fail, it won't be a big deal."
He thought to himself, and then took out three precious medicines.
These three treasure medicines all exceed the spiritual light level of eight feet and three feet. It can be said that they are more than enough to light the second divine lamp.
He didn't hesitate and drank all three herbs.
Now he has learned to be smart. After picking up the precious medicine, he will first take off some corners and try it out.
Anyone who notices something slightly wrong with the effect of the medicine will be left behind by him.In the bronze tripod, I don't plan to take it.
Because of the hallucinogenic mushrooms before, he was deceived.
I thought that the effect of the medicine would only make him feel a little dizzy, which would be no problem, but because of the strong stamina, he went crazy for several days.
Now, if it is not necessary, he will only take those precious medicines that have no abnormal effects at all.
And in these ten days, there were two treasures of medicine that were very strange.
Even one of the two treasures is a mushroom treasure.
It was a mushroom that was as red as blood and covered with dense white dots. It looked very strange at first glance and could never be a normal medicinal thing.
Chen Fengqi already had a deep resistance to mushroom-based medicines and didn't even want to taste them, so he didn't know their efficacy.
